title: Hernando County Commission, District 4
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Republican primary result from Hernando Sun (https://www.hernandosun.com/2026/08/18/the-votes-are-in-who-won-hernando-county-commission-and-school-board-races/); article says Holcomb 'advances to the November General Election' but the opponent's name was not in snippets. District 2 (Kathryn Birren) was decided in the primary with no November opponent.

candidates.name: Jeff Holcomb
candidates.background: Won the Republican nomination for County Commission District 4 over Marvin Baynham.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18 Republican primary with 59.07% (13,139) over Marvin Baynham 40.93% (9,103) (Hernando Sun)
